svg.title: Agent BMO trading loop
svg.desc: A nine state machine: scan, filter, analyze, decide, validate, execute, manage, exit, repeat. A sweep and a packet travel the ring. Filter, decide and validate can drop, pass or veto.

g.text: read new pools and price moves
drop tokens that fail hard rules
act or pass. reason is logged
sign and send from bmo wallet

svg.text: shown at 1.5 s per state. real cadence is set by strategy and market.
